kind: ADDITIVE. Observability audit, objective-family comparison and conditional preregistration. No fit, rollout, episode, collection, promotion, sigma or production change. No prior artifact is mutated
architect_decision: the pointwise push-off weight is DISCARDED after S1C-1 (three candidates, all FAIL P_preservation, all quarantined)

OBSERVABILITY_AUDIT_PREREGISTERED_BEFORE.question: do the frozen 35D inputs distinguish the rows of the continuous NEGATIVE AB06 IK ankle window from the neighbouring rows whose target is non-negative?
OBSERVABILITY_AUDIT_PREREGISTERED_BEFORE.label: y = 1 iff the decoded IK ankle target q = 0.7*u_IK[:,1] is negative; measured structure on the 500 frozen rows: 97 positives (19.4%) in 7 contiguous runs of lengths [9, 21, 6, 24, 5, 23, 9]
OBSERVABILITY_AUDIT_PREREGISTERED_BEFORE.splits: the FROZEN rev3n geometry: 5 contiguous blocked folds of 100 rows with embargo 10, train-only standardisation, constants excluded per fold. No new split is invented

feature_sets.runtime_available: all 35 minus the dead prescribed clock (0,1) and minus any feature constant on the fold's training rows. This is the set the deployed policy actually sees
feature_sets.physical_only_diagnostic: the runtime-available set minus the online phase family (14,15 online gait phase sin/cos, 16 cycle duration, 20,21 phase_expected_hs/to, 22,23 stance/swing elapsed norm, 24 cycle progress credit). DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: it answers whether localisation leans on the online phase estimate, and its failure is NOT by itself a NO-GO, because those features are legitimately available at runtime

estimators: kNN k=5 majority classifier on the standardised state
kNN k=5 regression of the signed IK ankle target, reporting the conditional-variance ratio Var(residual)/Var(target)
controls: block-permutation null: labels permuted by contiguous blocks of 25 rows, 20 repetitions, seed 2026, to calibrate what temporal autocorrelation alone can produce
cross-class versus intra-class nearest-neighbour distance contrast, to detect aliasing directly
per-fold reporting, because fold [301,400] contains only 5 positives

GO_NO_GO_CRITERION_FROZEN.GO: on the RUNTIME-AVAILABLE feature set, pooled over the 5 folds: balanced accuracy >= 0.75 AND positive-class recall >= 0.60 AND balanced accuracy exceeding the block-permutation null mean by >= 0.10
GO_NO_GO_CRITERION_FROZEN.NO_GO: any of the three conditions fails
GO_NO_GO_CRITERION_FROZEN.thresholds_are_a_priori: 0.75, 0.60 and 0.10 are round values chosen before any classification was run; they are declared as chosen, not derived
GO_NO_GO_CRITERION_FROZEN.consequence_of_NO_GO: the S1C-2 fit is NOT authorised and the minimal architectural correction is proposed as a SEPARATE stage; no objective-function change can create information the input lacks

A_supervised_phase_window_target.idea: keep the per-row supervised form but replace the pointwise label on the push-off rows with a window-consistent target (identical or smoothed target across the contiguous negative block), so the network is asked for a coherent block rather than 73 independent rows
A_supervised_phase_window_target.causal_MLP_compatibility: FULL: the policy still maps s_t -> a_t with no memory; the label is computed offline from already-recorded data, so no runtime input changes and no future observation is used
A_supervised_phase_window_target.training_machinery: unchanged: the frozen row-shuffled T1R union and the group-balanced per-role means continue to apply; no sequential minibatch is required
A_supervised_phase_window_target.clock_dependence: none at runtime. The window is defined offline on the recorded IK target; the policy must still infer it from the state
A_supervised_phase_window_target.precondition: the window must be OBSERVABLE from the state, otherwise the network averages across aliased rows - exactly the fragmentation measured in S1C-1

B_run_fragmentation_temporal_consistency.idea: penalise fragmentation of the output's negative runs, or penalise sign changes between consecutive outputs
B_run_fragmentation_temporal_consistency.requires_sequential_minibatches: YES: the loss couples outputs at consecutive time steps, so batches must be contiguous ordered segments instead of the frozen shuffled union. This is a structural change to the training loop and would invalidate the group-balanced per-role mechanism as currently frozen
B_run_fragmentation_temporal_consistency.future_dependence: a run length at t needs outputs at t+1... A backward-only variant (a_t versus a_{t-1}) is causal within the loss. In either case the POLICY stays causal, because a non-causal LOSS at training time does not make a non-causal INPUT at runtime; this distinction must be stated explicitly in any future protocol
B_run_fragmentation_temporal_consistency.avoiding_absolute_clock: the loss must use only relative differences between consecutive outputs inside a segment. If it used the phase field or absolute time to define windows it would reintroduce a clock dependence that the runtime policy cannot exploit, since the prescribed clock columns are hard-zeroed
B_run_fragmentation_temporal_consistency.fundamental_limit: a temporal loss CANNOT create information the input lacks. If two rows are aliased in 35D a memoryless network must emit the same action for both, so the fragmentation would be irreducible by any loss

OBJECTIVE_FAMILY_COMPARISON_NO_TRAINING.shared_precondition: both families reduce to the SAME precondition, which is exactly what the observability audit decides. This is why the audit gates the choice rather than following it

preference_rule_frozen_before_the_audit.if_GO: family A is preferred: it achieves the same objective without sequential minibatches, without any future dependence and without touching the frozen T1R mechanism, so it changes one thing at a time
preference_rule_frozen_before_the_audit.if_NO_GO: neither family is authorised; the minimal architectural correction is proposed separately

S1C_2_PROTOCOL_CONDITIONAL_ON_GO.status: PREREGISTERED BUT NOT AUTHORISED. It may be executed only after an explicit architect token, and only if the audit returns GO
S1C_2_PROTOCOL_CONDITIONAL_ON_GO.init: EXCLUSIVELY S0D 481dd0d2... (August V26 imitation -> 35D). W2/W4/W8, A1..A6, S1A, A2 are forbidden as init, source or anchor. July is used ONLY as parametric anchor 1e-5 and as benchmark, NEVER as init or label
S1C_2_PROTOCOL_CONDITIONAL_ON_GO.objective: family A: two-role loss with r = 5 unchanged; the TASK label on the rows of each contiguous negative IK window is replaced by the WINDOW-CONSISTENT target (the mean of the decoded IK target over that window, re-encoded to the action convention); all other task rows keep their pointwise label
S1C_2_PROTOCOL_CONDITIONAL_ON_GO.candidate_grid: the window-target blend beta_w in {0.5, 0.75, 1.0}, where the task label on a window row is (1-beta_w)*pointwise + beta_w*window_mean. beta_w = 0 would reproduce A2 and is therefore excluded
S1C_2_PROTOCOL_CONDITIONAL_ON_GO.splits_unchanged: the frozen 380 training rows (steps 1-190, 311-500), holdout 201-300, embargo 191-200 and 301-310
S1C_2_PROTOCOL_CONDITIONAL_ON_GO.gates_unchanged: the rev3s hierarchy I -> P -> T -> D with the rev3v thresholds EXACTLY as frozen. No threshold is changed, added or removed
S1C_2_PROTOCOL_CONDITIONAL_ON_GO.preregistered_persistence_diagnostics: identical to rev3x: duty cycle, run count, mean and max run length of the negative command on the ordered held-out rows, plus the predicted served reference through the rev3w validated replica, plus the same quantities for S0D, A2 and the AB06 IK target. Non-binding, no thresholds, B3 remains INDETERMINATE while the phase field is null
S1C_2_PROTOCOL_CONDITIONAL_ON_GO.materialisation: candidates/S1C2_<ID>_35D_NONDEPLOYABLE, no-clobber, deployable false; the rollout/promotion status MUST be derived from the offline verdict per the rev3x status addendum

MINIMAL_ARCHITECTURAL_CORRECTION_IF_NO_G.status: PROPOSAL ONLY, separate stage, not authorised here
MINIMAL_ARCHITECTURAL_CORRECTION_IF_NO_G.principle: if the window is not observable from the runtime-available state, the deficit is informational and no loss can repair it. The minimal correction adds observability, not capacity
options_ranked_by_invasiveness: 1. a short causal feature window: feed the policy a small fixed lag stack of already-available physical channels (for example the ankle angle and the GRF over the last k steps). It stays causal and needs no new sensor, but it changes the 35D input contract and therefore the deployable actor definition
2. minimal recurrence: a single-state memory on the existing inputs. Strictly more invasive than the lag stack and harder to certify against the frozen invariants
3. exposing an existing but currently unused signal, if the audit shows the deficit is localised to one missing channel
MINIMAL_ARCHITECTURAL_CORRECTION_IF_NO_G.explicitly_not_proposed: no change to env, reward, FSM, morphology, SEA, corridor or C++ is proposed by this document

prohibitions: no change to the rev3v gates or thresholds
no mutation of any prior artifact
